definition_zh: 逐渐变细；一端渐细的东西；细蜡烛；逐渐减少
definition_en: to become gradually narrower toward one end, or a long thin candle that burns with a small flame
core_image: 一根长条从粗的一端缓缓收窄，到顶端只剩一个尖
scene: 聚会散场，桌上的蜡烛越烧越短，火焰也越来越小。At the end of the party, the taper on the table grew shorter and shorter.
sceneCN: 这里 taper 是「细蜡烛」（第 3 个义项：细长而用来照明的小蜡烛）；句意：聚会散场时，桌上的那根细蜡烛越烧越短。

pos.zh: 逐渐变细；逐渐减少
使逐渐变细
细长蜡烛；渐细的锥形物

derivatives.zh: 由 taper 加 -ed 构成，义为「锥形的；逐渐变细的」
由 taper 加 -ing 构成，义为「逐渐变细的；逐渐减少的」
由 tapering 加 -ly 构成，义为「逐渐变细地」

senses.title: To become gradually narrower
senses.definition: to become gradually thinner or narrower toward one end
senses.definitionCN: 朝一端逐渐变薄、变窄
senses.example: The branches taper toward the top of the tree.
senses.exampleCN: 树枝越往树顶越细。
senses.why: The core image is a shape that keeps losing width along its length, so the verb names that steady narrowing.
senses.whyCN: 核心意象是一条沿长度不断失去宽度的形状，动词正是描述这种持续收窄的过程。

senses.title: To grow smaller in amount
senses.definition: to decrease gradually in amount, strength, or activity
senses.definitionCN: 数量、强度或活动逐渐减少
senses.example: Sales usually taper off after the holiday.
senses.exampleCN: 节日过后销量通常逐渐减少。
senses.why: A narrowing line looks like a diminishing quantity, so the shape metaphor spreads to numbers and effort.
senses.whyCN: 收窄的线条看起来就像数量在缩减，于是这种形状比喻延伸到数字与投入上。

senses.title: A thin candle
senses.definition: a long thin candle that gives a small light
senses.definitionCN: 细长的小蜡烛，光很小
senses.example: She lit a taper in the dim hallway.
senses.exampleCN: 她在昏暗的走廊里点了一根细蜡烛。
senses.why: Old candles were made long and thin so that they tapered, and the object took the name of its shape.
senses.whyCN: 古时的蜡烛做得又长又细，正好呈锥形，于是这件器物就以它的形状命名。

senses.title: A narrowing shape
senses.definition: the part of an object that narrows toward its end
senses.definitionCN: 物体朝末端变细的那一段
senses.example: The handle has a slight taper near the grip.
senses.exampleCN: 手柄靠近握把处略有收窄。
senses.why: The verb sense resurfaced as a noun for the resulting shape, as in the taper of a pipe.
senses.whyCN: 动词的意义又回到名词形态，用来指收窄后的形状，例如管子的锥段。

senses.title: To make something thinner
senses.definition: to shape or cut something so that it narrows
senses.definitionCN: 把某物加工或切削成逐渐变细的形状
senses.example: He taper the wood into a fine point.
senses.exampleCN: 他把木头削成一个尖头。
senses.why: The same narrowing can be done by a hand or a tool, giving a transitive use of the verb.
senses.whyCN: 同一种收窄既可以自然发生，也可以由手或工具完成，于是动词有了及物用法。

intro.en: Taper probably goes back to Latin papyrus through an Old English word for a wick, papir.
intro.cn: taper 一般认为经古英语 papir（灯芯）上溯到拉丁语 papyrus（纸莎草）。

items.en: Papyrus names the reed used for ancient writing and for wicks.
items.cn: papyrus 指古代用来书写、也用来做灯芯的纸莎草。

items.en: Papir means a wick, perhaps through Latin papyrus.
items.cn: 古英语 papir 意为灯芯，一般认为与拉丁语 papyrus 有关。

items.en: Taper first names a wax candle or wick, which was long and thin.
items.cn: taper 最初指又长又细的蜡烛或烛芯。

items.en: The shape of the candle gives the verb to taper, meaning to grow thin.
items.cn: 由蜡烛的细长形状引申出动词 to taper，意为变细。

items.en: Taper extends to numbers, prices, and effort that taper off.
items.cn: 现代英语把 taper 用于逐渐减少的数字、价格和投入。

items.en: The link to Latin papyrus is probable but not certain; some sources say the origin is uncertain.
items.cn: 与拉丁语 papyrus 的联系只是较可能的推测，并非定论，也有资料注明来源不确定。

note.en: Taper belongs to a family of narrowing words, next to shape terms such as cone and wedge.
note.cn: taper 属于一组表示「逐渐收窄」的词，与 cone、wedge 等形状词相邻。

entries.definition: becoming narrower toward one end
entries.definitionCN: 锥形的；逐渐变细的

entries.definition: gradually getting thinner
entries.definitionCN: 逐渐变细的

entries.definition: a heavy cloth with pictures woven into it
entries.definitionCN: 挂毯；织锦（只是拼写相近，词源不同）

entries.definition: small in width
entries.definitionCN: 狭窄的

entries.definition: a shape that narrows to a point
entries.definitionCN: 圆锥体

entries.definition: to become smaller in size or amount
entries.definitionCN: 减少；缩小

normalIntro.en: Taper is a candle that thins as it rises, and then anything that shrinks the same way.
normalIntro.cn: taper 就是一枝越往上越细的蜡烛，进而指一切按同样方式缩小的事物。

normal.en: To taper off means to lessen and finally stop.
normal.cn: taper off 指逐渐减弱并最终停止。

normal.en: The candle was a long taper that gave a soft light.
normal.cn: 那枝蜡烛是一根细长的 taper，发出柔和的光。

normal.en: Tapered and tapering are the two common adjective forms.
normal.cn: tapered 与 tapering 是两个常见的形容词形式。

normal.en: A road may taper from many lanes to one.
normal.cn: 一条路可以从多车道逐渐收窄成一车道。

normal.en: Compare narrow, which means thin all over, while taper means thin at one end only.
normal.cn: 对比 narrow：narrow 通体都窄，taper 只是一端渐细。

abstract.en: Picture a pencil sharpened to a fine tip.
abstract.cn: 想象一支被削出细尖的铅笔。

abstract.en: Imagine a crowd leaving a hall and thinning out at the door.
abstract.cn: 想象人群离场，在门口逐渐变稀。

abstract.en: Think of a candle burning down to a small glow.
abstract.cn: 想象一枝蜡烛燃到只剩微光。

examples.en: The complaint tapered off after the new manager arrived.
examples.cn: 新经理到任后，投诉渐渐少了。

examples.en: Her hair was cut so that it tapered at the back.
examples.cn: 她的头发剪成后面逐渐收细的样式。

examples.en: A taper burned on the altar during the service.
examples.cn: 仪式期间，祭坛上点着一根细蜡烛。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「特配」——火苗特别配这一根细蜡烛；只是谐音联想，与词源无关。

root: 一般认为源于拉丁语 papyrus（纸莎草）→ 古英语 papir（灯芯）→ 中古英语 taper（细蜡烛）→ 引申为「渐细」；与拉丁语的联系属推测，并非定论。

sensesIntro.en: Taper begins with the candle, moves to the shape of that candle, and then spreads to anything that narrows or shrinks.
sensesIntro.cn: taper 从蜡烛起家，先指蜡烛的形状，再扩展到一切逐渐收窄或减少的事物。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a long strip that narrows to a point at one end.
core.cn: 核心意象：一条朝一端收窄成尖的长条。

branches.en: The shape sense is the basic everyday use.
branches.cn: 形状义是最日常的基本用法。

branches.en: A narrowing line becomes a falling amount.
branches.cn: 收窄的线条引申为下降的数量。

branches.en: The candle is the oldest concrete sense.
branches.cn: 蜡烛是最早的具体义项。

branches.en: The shape itself can be named as a noun.
branches.cn: 收窄的形状本身可以作名词使用。

branches.en: A hand or tool can make the narrowing happen.
branches.cn: 手或工具可以主动制造这种收窄。

intro.en: Taper has no productive English prefix or suffix, but English builds tapered, tapering, and taperingly around it, along with compounds such as taper candle.
intro.cn: taper 没有能产的英语前后缀，但英语围绕它构成 tapered、tapering 与 taperingly，并有 taper candle 这类复合词。

latinIntro.en: The probable Latin source is papyrus, the reed that gave ancient wicks and paper.
latinIntro.cn: 较可能的拉丁语来源是 papyrus，即古代用来做灯芯和纸的纸莎草。

items.meaning: to become thinner toward one end
items.example: Taper is the base verb.
items.exampleCN: taper 是基础动词。

items.meaning: forming an adjective from a verb
items.meaningCN: 把动词变为形容词的词尾
items.example: The suffix -ed forms tapered.
items.exampleCN: 词尾 -ed 构成 tapered。

items.example: Tapered describes a leg or a pipe.
items.exampleCN: tapered 可形容腿或管道。

items.meaningCN: 构成现在分词或形容词的词尾
items.example: The suffix -ing forms tapering.
items.exampleCN: 词尾 -ing 构成 tapering。

items.example: Tapering hair is short at the back.
items.exampleCN: tapering 可形容后面剪短的头发。

items.example: The suffix -ly forms taperingly.
items.exampleCN: 词尾 -ly 构成 taperingly。

items.meaningCN: 表示减弱到没有的副词小品词
items.example: The particle off forms taper off.
items.exampleCN: 小品词 off 构成 taper off。

items.example: Taper candle pairs the noun sense with candle.
items.exampleCN: taper candle 把名词义与 candle 结合起来。

items.example: Taper point names the narrow end of a shape.
items.exampleCN: taper point 指形状收窄的末端。

definition_zh: 皮重；容器重量；皮重扣除；（圣经用语）稗子
definition_en: the weight of a container or packaging, which is subtracted to find the weight of the goods inside
core_image: 货车过秤时，先把空车称一次，重量归零，再把货物倒进去
scene: 称重时，店员先把空纸箱放上秤，按下去皮键让读数归零，再倒入咖啡豆。The clerk weighed the empty box first, then pressed the tare key so the scale would ignore the container.
sceneCN: 这里 tare 是「皮重、容器重量」（第 2 个义项：容器或包装本身的重量）；句意：店员先称空纸箱，再按下去皮键，让秤忽略容器重量。

pos.zh: 皮重；容器重量；包装重量
扣除皮重；把秤调零

derivatives.zh: 由 tare 加 -ed 构成，义为「已扣除皮重的；已调零的」
由 tare 加 -ing 构成，义为「去皮；调零」

senses.title: The weight of the container
senses.definition: the weight of a container or packaging, counted separately from the goods
senses.definitionCN: 容器或包装本身的重量，与货物的重量分开计算
senses.example: The tare of each crate is printed on the side.
senses.exampleCN: 每个木箱的皮重都印在箱侧。
senses.why: Every scale weighs the container along with the cargo, so the container needed its own name and it became tare.
senses.whyCN: 秤总是连容器一起称，于是容器自身的重量需要一个专门名称，这就是 tare。

senses.title: A deduction for the container
senses.definition: the amount subtracted from a total weight to leave the weight of the goods alone
senses.definitionCN: 从总重量中减去、只留下货物净重的那部分数值
senses.example: After deducting the tare, the coffee weighed five kilos.
senses.exampleCN: 扣除皮重后，咖啡重五公斤。
senses.why: The same figure can be pictured as a subtraction, so tare also names the number taken off the scale.
senses.whyCN: 同一个数值也可以看成一次减法，于是 tare 又指从秤上减去的那部分。

senses.title: To set a scale to zero
senses.definition: to adjust a balance or scale so that a container reads as zero
senses.definitionCN: 调整天平或称，使放了容器时读数归零
senses.example: Tare the bowl before you add the flour.
senses.exampleCN: 加面粉之前先把碗的重量去掉。
senses.why: From the noun came a verb: to tare is to make the instrument ignore the container in one movement.
senses.whyCN: 名词又生出动词：to tare 就是一次操作让仪器忽略容器。

senses.title: A weed in the wheat
senses.definition: in the Bible, a harmful weed that looks like wheat
senses.definitionCN: 圣经中指与小麦相似的有害杂草
senses.example: The servants asked whether to pull up the tares.
senses.exampleCN: 仆人们问是否要把稗子拔掉。
senses.why: An older word tare named a weed whose seeds look like wheat, and figurative use grew from the image of bad seeds among good ones.
senses.whyCN: 较早还有一个同形词 tare，指种子像小麦的杂草，坏种混在好种里的意象由此引申。

intro.en: Tare for container weight comes through French from Arabic tarh, a throwing down or deduction.
intro.cn: 表示容器重量的 tare 经法语来自阿拉伯语 tarh（抛下、扣除）。

items.en: Tarh means throwing down or taking away, and came to mean what is deducted.
items.cn: 阿拉伯语 tarh 意为抛下、拿走，引申为被扣除的部分。

items.en: Merchants in Italian trade ports wrote it as tara in weight records.
items.cn: 意大利贸易港口的商人把它在称重记录中写作 tara。

items.en: Tara names the weight of a container in shipping accounts.
items.cn: 意大利语 tara 在航运账目中指容器重量。

items.en: Tare passes into French and into English trade records.
items.cn: tare 进入法语，并进入英语的贸易记录。

items.en: Tare becomes a verb, as in tare the scale, and gives the phrase tare weight.
items.cn: 现代英语中 tare 变成动词，如 tare the scale，并产生 tare weight 这一说法。

items.en: The weed tare is a separate, much older word, probably related to Old English tæru; it is not from Arabic.
items.cn: 表示稗子的 tare 是另一个更古老的词，可能与古英语 tæru 有关，并非来自阿拉伯语。

note.en: Tare is a weighing word, close to tare weight, and to the balancing terms around it.
note.cn: tare 是称重领域的词，与 tare weight 以及周围的计量术语相邻。

entries.definition: with the container weight removed
entries.definitionCN: 已扣除皮重的

entries.definition: the weight of the empty container
entries.definitionCN: 皮重；空容器重量

entries.definition: to pull paper or cloth apart
entries.definitionCN: 撕裂（只是拼写相近、词源不同）

entries.definition: the weight of goods plus their container
entries.definitionCN: 毛重；含容器的总重量

entries.definition: the weight of the goods alone
entries.definitionCN: 净重；货物本身的重量

entries.definition: an amount taken away from a total
entries.definitionCN: 扣除；扣除额

normalIntro.en: Tare is the empty box on the scale, the weight that must be taken away before the goods count.
normalIntro.cn: tare 就是秤上那只空箱子，是计算货物之前必须扣掉的那份重量。

normal.en: Tare weight is the weight of the empty packaging.
normal.cn: tare weight 是空包装的重量。

normal.en: The tared reading shows only the goods.
normal.cn: 扣除皮重后的读数只显示货物重量。

normal.en: Most scales have a tare key that works in one second.
normal.cn: 大多数秤都有去皮键，一秒就能调零。

normal.en: Gross weight minus tare equals net weight.
normal.cn: 毛重减去皮重等于净重。

normal.en: Compare tare with tear, which sounds the same but means to rip.
normal.cn: 对比 tear：读音相同，但意思是撕开。

abstract.en: Picture an empty crate being weighed before the fruit goes in.
abstract.cn: 想象水果装进之前，先称一只空箱子。

abstract.en: Imagine a pointer that stops at a red hairline after the button is pressed.
abstract.cn: 想象按下按钮后，指针停在一条红色细线上。

abstract.en: Think of a scale that shows only what matters and forgets the box.
abstract.cn: 想象一台只显示真正要紧部分、忘掉箱子的秤。

examples.en: Record the tare before filling the sack with grain.
examples.cn: 往袋子里装谷物之前先记下皮重。

examples.en: The ancient tares grew tall among the young wheat.
examples.cn: 古老的稗子在嫩麦丛中长得很高。

examples.en: She tared the measuring cup and weighed out the sugar.
examples.cn: 她先把量杯去皮，然后称出白糖。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「台儿」——先称台上的空箱子，扣掉它才轮到货物；只是谐音联想，与词源无关。

root: 阿拉伯语 tarh（抛下、拿走）→ 中世纪意大利贸易用语 tara → 法语 tare → 英语 tare，核心义「从总重中拿掉的容器重量」；稗子义的同形词与本义无关。

sensesIntro.en: Tare starts as the weight of the container, becomes the amount subtracted, then the act of zeroing a scale, and finally an unrelated older word for a weed.
sensesIntro.cn: tare 先是容器自身的重量，再指被减去的数值，然后是给秤调零的动作，最后还有一个与之无关的古老「稗子」义。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: an empty crate on the scale, weighed before the goods go in.
core.cn: 核心意象：货物装入之前，先称一只空箱子。

branches.en: The container weight is the basic trade sense.
branches.cn: 容器重量是基本的贸易义项。

branches.en: The deducted amount is the same figure seen as a subtraction.
branches.cn: 被扣除的数值是同一数字的减法视角。

branches.en: The verb turns the reading into an action on the scale.
branches.cn: 动词把读数转化为对秤的操作。

branches.en: The container weight and its deduction together give the net weight.
branches.cn: 容器重量与它的扣除合起来得出净重。

branches.en: The weed sense is a separate older word that happens to look the same.
branches.cn: 稗子义属于另一个更古老、恰好同形的词。

intro.en: Tare is a loanword of Arabic origin, and English builds tared and taring around it and pairs it in compounds like tare weight.
intro.cn: tare 是源自阿拉伯语的借词，英语围绕它构成 tared 与 taring，并在 tare weight 这类复合词中与别的词配对。

latinIntro.en: The path runs from Arabic tarh through medieval Italian and French, so no Latin root actually forms this English word.
latinIntro.cn: 词形路径是从阿拉伯语 tarh 经中世纪意大利语和法语而来，英语这个词并没有真正的拉丁语词根。

items.example: Tare is the borrowed base word.
items.exampleCN: tare 是借来的基础词。

items.meaning: to set a scale to zero
items.example: Tare also works as a short verb.
items.exampleCN: tare 也用作简短的动词。

items.meaning: forming a past participle or adjective
items.meaningCN: 构成过去分词或形容词的词尾
items.example: The suffix -ed forms tared.
items.exampleCN: 词尾 -ed 构成 tared。

items.example: Tared readings show only the goods.
items.exampleCN: tared 的读数只显示货物。

items.example: The suffix -ing forms taring.
items.exampleCN: 词尾 -ing 构成 taring。

items.meaning: the act of zeroing a balance
items.example: Taring takes only a moment.
items.exampleCN: taring 只需要一瞬间。

items.example: Weight forms the compound tare weight.
items.exampleCN: weight 构成复合词 tare weight。

items.meaning: the weight of the empty container
items.example: Tare weight appears on the bill of lading.
items.exampleCN: tare weight 会写在提单上。

items.meaning: a button that sets the scale to zero
items.example: Tare key is common on kitchen scales.
items.exampleCN: tare key 在厨房秤上很常见。

definition_zh: 流苏；穗饰；（玉米的）雄花穗
definition_en: a bunch of short threads hanging from the top or edge of something as a decoration
core_image: 帽子或窗帘边垂下一把短穗子，风一吹就轻轻摆动
scene: 毕业典礼上，学生头上的帽子随风轻摆，垂下的穗子扫过封面。During the graduation ceremony, the tassel on his cap swung as he walked.
sceneCN: 这里 tassel 是「流苏、穗饰」（第 1 个义项：挂在物件顶部或边上的成把短绳）；句意：毕业典礼上，他走路时帽顶的流苏来回摆动。

pos.zh: 流苏；穗饰；雄花穗
装流苏；结成流苏状

derivatives.zh: 由 tassel 加 -led 构成，义为「带流苏的」
由 tassel 加 -ly 构成，义为「像流苏一样散垂的」，较少用

senses.title: A hanging bunch of threads
senses.definition: a bunch of short threads or cords hanging from something as decoration
senses.definitionCN: 一束短绳或线挂在某物上作装饰
senses.example: A red tassel hung from the corner of the cushion.
senses.exampleCN: 靠垫的一角挂着一个红色流苏。
senses.why: The core image is a grip of loose threads tied at the top, so the noun names that hanging bunch.
senses.whyCN: 核心意象是一把在顶部束紧的散线，名词正是这束垂下的东西。

senses.title: Decorating with a tassel
senses.definition: to put tassels on something as an ornament
senses.definitionCN: 在某物上装上流苏作点缀
senses.example: They tassel the edge of the banner with silk.
senses.exampleCN: 他们用丝绸给横幅的边缘装上流苏。
senses.why: Once the noun was concrete, a verb could describe the act of fixing those bunches to cloth.
senses.whyCN: 名词具体化之后，动词就可以描述把这种穗束缀到布上的动作。

senses.title: The grainy head of a plant
senses.definition: the brush-like flower at the top of a corn plant
senses.definitionCN: 玉米植株顶端像刷子一样的花序
senses.example: The tassel on the corn had turned a pale brown.
senses.exampleCN: 玉米顶端的雄花穗变成了浅褐色。
senses.why: The corn flower looks like a bunch of loose strings, so plant experts gave it the same word.
senses.whyCN: 玉米顶花看上去就像一把散开的细线，植物学者便借用了这个词。

senses.title: A small ornamental cap
senses.definition: a small cap decorated with a tassel, worn on some formal occasions
senses.definitionCN: 在某些正式场合佩戴的带流苏小帽子
senses.example: The old professor still kept his college tassel in a drawer.
senses.exampleCN: 那位老教授仍把他的学院小帽收在抽屉里。
senses.why: The decoration came to stand for the object itself, so the tassel could name the cap that carried it.
senses.whyCN: 装饰物转而代表整件器物，于是流苏一词也可以指承载它的帽子。

intro.en: Tassel probably comes from Latin taxillus, a small die or a pebble-shaped clasp.
intro.cn: tassel 一般认为来自拉丁语 taxillus（小骰子、小块的扣饰）。

items.en: Taxillus is a little die, a small block used in games.
items.cn: taxillus 是小骰子，游戏里的小块。

items.en: Tassel names a clasp or a fastening of cloth.
items.cn: 古法语 tassel 指布上的扣子或系结。

items.en: Tassel arrives as a kind of fastening on clothing.
items.cn: tassel 最初指衣物上的一种系扣。

items.en: The word shifts to the hanging ornament now called a tassel.
items.cn: 这个词转而指今天所说的垂挂装饰流苏。

items.en: Botany adopts tassel for the flower at the top of corn.
items.cn: 植物学借用 tassel 指玉米顶部的花穗。

items.en: The path from Latin taxillus to Old French tassel is generally accepted, but some detail is uncertain.
items.cn: 从拉丁语 taxillus 到古法语 tassel 的路径一般被接受，但个别细节仍有不确定之处。

note.en: Tassel is a decoration word, close to its own forms and to other trimming terms.
note.cn: tassel 是装饰类词汇，与它的各种形式及其他流苏、垂饰类词相邻。

entries.definition: the act of decorating with tassels
entries.definitionCN: 装流苏；垂成穗状

normalIntro.en: Tassel is a bundle of loose strings tied at the top, swaying from a cap or a curtain.
normalIntro.cn: tassel 是在顶部束紧的一把散线，从帽子或窗帘上轻轻摆动。

normal.en: The tasselled blanket was warm and soft.
normal.cn: 那条带流苏的毯子又暖又软。

normal.en: Tassels hang at the corners of the flag.
normal.cn: 流苏挂在旗帜的各个角上。

normal.en: You move the tassel to one side at graduation.
normal.cn: 毕业典礼上要把流苏拨到另一边。

normal.en: A tassel can also mean the flower at the top of corn.
normal.cn: tassel 也可以指玉米顶端的花穗。

normal.en: Compare fringe, which is a whole edge of threads, while a tassel is one hanging bunch.
normal.cn: 对比 fringe：fringe 是整条流苏边，tassel 是单独一束。

abstract.en: Picture a silk cord tied tight at the top and fraying loose below.
abstract.cn: 想象一根丝绳在顶部扎紧，下头散成松散的丝线。

abstract.en: Imagine the tassel swinging as someone walks in a cap.
abstract.cn: 想象一个人戴着帽子走路时流苏左右摆动。

abstract.en: Think of a corn plant brushing the sky with its soft head.
abstract.cn: 想象一株玉米用柔软的花穗轻刷天空。

examples.en: The curtains were tied back with silk tassels.
examples.cn: 窗帘用丝质流苏束在两边。

examples.en: Every graduate wore a tasselled cap.
examples.cn: 每位毕业生都戴着带穗的帽子。

examples.en: Wind passed through the tassels of the tall corn.
examples.cn: 风穿过高高的玉米雄花穗。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「他缩」——帽子上的穗子风一吹就缩成一束；只是谐音联想，与词源无关。

root: 一般认为源自拉丁语 taxillus（小骰子、小块）→ 古法语 tassel（衣物系扣）→ 中古英语 tassel → 现代英语「流苏；穗饰」。

sensesIntro.en: Tassel names the hanging bunch of threads, its use as a verb, the corn flower that looks the same, and the small cap that carries it.
sensesIntro.cn: tassel 先指垂下的穗束，再作动词表示装上流苏，又指形似的玉米雄花穗，最后指带有这种装饰的小帽。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a bunch of threads tied at the top and hanging loose.
core.cn: 核心意象：顶部扎紧、下方散垂的一束线。

branches.en: The hanging bunch is the modern everyday sense.
branches.cn: 垂下的穗束是今天最常用的义项。

branches.en: A verb grew for the act of adding the decoration.
branches.cn: 表示装上这种装饰的动词由此产生。

branches.en: The corn flower borrowed the shape of the threads.
branches.cn: 玉米雄花穗借用了散线的形状。

branches.en: The decoration stood for the cap it adorned.
branches.cn: 装饰物转而代表它所点缀的小帽。

branches.en: A cloth ornament and a plant head share the same loose, stringy look.
branches.cn: 布上的流苏与植物顶穗共享同一种散垂如线的外形。

intro.en: Tassel has no productive English prefix, but English forms tasselled and tasselling and compounds such as tassel curtain.
intro.cn: tassel 没有能产的英语前缀，但英语构成 tasselled、tasselling 以及 tassel curtain 等复合词。

latinIntro.en: The Latin ancestor is taxillus, a small die, whose shape carried over into the French clasp.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语祖先 taxillus 意为小骰子，其形状感延续到法语的系扣之中。

items.exampleCN: tassel 是借来的基础词。

items.example: Tassel also serves as a verb.

items.meaningCN: 用于 -el 结尾动词的分词词尾

items.example: Tasselled cloth is common on theatre curtains.

items.meaningCN: 把动词变为名词的词尾

items.exampleCN: 词尾 -ling 构成 tasselling。

definition_zh: 嘲弄；讥讽；奚落；嘲讽的话；嘲弄的对象
definition_en: to say unkind, mocking things to someone in order to annoy or upset them
core_image: 有人站在栅栏外，指着里面的人尖声喊话，故意惹对方发火
scene: 操场上两个男生隔着铁丝网喊话，想激怒对面的人。On the playground, two boys shouted at a new pupil across the wire fence to taunt him.
sceneCN: 这里 taunt 是「嘲弄；奚落」（第 1 个义项：用刻薄的话故意激怒某人）；句意：操场上，两个男生隔着铁丝网朝一个新来的学生喊话，故意嘲弄他。

pos.zh: 嘲弄；讥讽；奚落；故意激怒
嘲讽的话；嘲弄的对象

derivatives.zh: 由 taunting 加分词后缀 -ly 构成，义为「嘲弄地；挑衅地」
由动词加 -ing 构成的分词形容词，义为「嘲讽的；挑衅的」
由动词加施事后缀 -er 构成，义为「嘲弄者；挑衅者」

senses.title: To mock someone deliberately to provoke them
senses.definition: to say mocking, unkind things to someone on purpose to make them angry or upset
senses.definitionCN: 故意说刻薄、讥讽的话，让对方生气或难受
senses.example: The crowd taunted the goalkeeper after his mistake.
senses.exampleCN: 守门员失误之后，观众对他百般奚落。
senses.why: The French source taunter already meant to provoke someone with jeering words, so the core image is speech aimed like a spear at another person.
senses.whyCN: 法语来源 taunter 本义就是「用讥笑的话挑衅别人」，核心意象是像投标枪一样把话说向对方，所以首要义项是刻意用话激人。

senses.title: A mocking remark meant to wound
senses.definition: a remark made to hurt or annoy someone by mocking them
senses.definitionCN: 为了伤害或惹恼别人而说出的讥讽话语
senses.example: Their taunts followed him all the way home.
senses.exampleCN: 他们的嘲讽一路跟着他到家里。
senses.why: The single act of jeering can be counted as a thing, so the verb also gives a noun for the words themselves.
senses.whyCN: 一次又一次的讥笑可以被当作可数的事物，于是动词义转出名词义，专指那些刺人的话语。

senses.title: A person or thing that is jeered at
senses.definition: a person or thing that others treat with mockery and contempt
senses.definitionCN: 被别人讥笑、轻视的人或事物
senses.example: In the end the boast became a taunt for the whole office.
senses.exampleCN: 到头来，那句大话成了全办公室的笑柄。
senses.why: Jeering needs a target, so the word sometimes shifts from the jeering words to the thing that receives them.
senses.whyCN: 讥笑总得有个对象，所以这个词有时从「讥笑的话」滑到「被讥笑的那一方」，成了笑柄的意思。

senses.title: To provoke with words or gestures
senses.definition: to try to make a person or animal react angrily, sometimes without saying a word
senses.definitionCN: 试图让对方发怒，有时并不说话，而是用动作或物件挑衅
senses.example: They taunted the bull with a red cloth.
senses.exampleCN: 他们用一块红布挑衅公牛。
senses.why: Since the aim of taunting is a reaction, the means can expand from words to gestures, so the verb covers any deliberate provocation.
senses.whyCN: 嘲弄的目的在于让对方有反应，手段自然可以从言语扩展到动作，于是动词也泛指一切故意挑衅的行为。

senses.title: To reproach as a bitter reminder
senses.definition: to remind someone of a fault or past failure in a bitter, mocking way
senses.definitionCN: 刻薄地提起别人的过失或旧账来讥讽对方
senses.example: The old man taunted the council with its broken promises.
senses.exampleCN: 老人拿议会违背的诺言来讥讽他们。
senses.why: When the mocking remark is pointed at a fault, the jeering turns into a bitter reminder, which is how taunt came to mean reproach.
senses.whyCN: 讥讽的话一旦对准别人的过错，就变成了尖酸的重提旧事，这就是 taunt 获得「责难、以某事相讥」义项的来路。

intro.en: Taunt comes from Old French taunter or tanter, to jeer at, whose own origin is uncertain although a Germanic explanation is often proposed.
intro.cn: taunt 来自古法语 taunter 或 tanter，意为讥笑，其更早来源不确定，一般认为可能与日耳曼语族有关。

items.en: A Germanic origin is often suggested, but no root is firmly established.
items.cn: 一般认为可能有日耳曼语族来源，但确切词根尚无定论。

items.en: Taunter and tanter mean to jeer at or provoke with words.
items.cn: 古法语 taunter、tanter 意为用言语讥笑、挑衅。

items.en: The verb is recorded during the sixteenth century with the sense of reproaching bitterly.
items.cn: 十六世纪英语中记录到这个动词，义为尖刻地责难。

items.en: The noun taunt, meaning a mocking remark, becomes established.
items.cn: 表示「讥讽之言」的名词 taunt 在十七至十八世纪确立。

items.en: Modern use covers playground teasing as well as provocation in sport and politics.
items.cn: 现代用法既包括校园里的讥笑，也涵盖体育与政治场合的挑衅。

note.en: Taunt is the word for jeering provocation; its family includes taunting and taunter, and it sits beside ordinary mocking and teasing words.
note.cn: taunt 是表示「讥讽挑衅」的词，词族包括 taunting、taunter，并与普通的嘲弄、戏弄类词相邻。

entries.definitionCN: 现在分词与分词形容词，意为嘲讽的；由本词加 -ing 构成

entries.definition: to shout rude remarks at someone
entries.definitionCN: 朝某人喊侮辱性的话；讥笑

entries.definition: to make fun of someone, often in a gentler way
entries.definitionCN: 戏弄；逗弄，语气通常比 taunt 轻

entries.definition: to make someone angry on purpose
entries.definitionCN: 故意激怒

normalIntro.en: Taunt is a word of jeering provocation, so the memory hook is a voice thrown at somebody on purpose to make them angry.
normalIntro.cn: taunt 是表示「讥讽挑衅」的词，记忆抓手就是特意朝某人抛出去、要让他发火的那句话。

normal.en: Taunt somebody about a fault means to keep mocking that fault.
normal.cn: taunt somebody about a fault 就是反复拿某个缺点讥笑对方。

normal.en: A taunt is the mocking sentence itself, while taunt is the act of saying it.
normal.cn: a taunt 指那句讥讽的话本身，动词 taunt 则指说出这句话的行为。

normal.en: The past form taunted and the noun taunt sound the same at the end.
normal.cn: 过去式 taunted 与名词 taunt 的词尾读音很接近。

normal.en: Taunting is about inducing a reaction, so the object is usually a person, a team, or a crowd.
normal.cn: taunt 意在激起反应，所以宾语通常是个人、球队或一群观众。

normal.en: Compare taunt with tease: taunt aims to hurt, tease often aims only to amuse.
normal.cn: 对比 taunt 与 tease：taunt 意在伤人，tease 往往只是想逗乐。

abstract.en: Picture a child on one side of a fence pointing and shouting across it.
abstract.cn: 想象一个孩子站在铁丝网一侧，指着对面大声叫喊。

abstract.en: Imagine words flying like small spears and landing on the listener.
abstract.cn: 想象话语像一支支小标枪飞出去，扎在听的人身上。

abstract.en: See a red cape waved in front of a bull again and again.
abstract.cn: 想象有人在公牛眼前一次次挥动红布。

examples.en: The older boys taunted him about his second-hand shoes.
examples.cn: 年长的男孩们拿他的旧鞋讥笑他。

examples.en: The manager had to endure taunts from the travelling fans.
examples.cn: 主教练只得忍受随队球迷的嘲讽。

examples.en: She refused to taunt the losing team after the final whistle.
examples.cn: 终场哨响后，她拒绝去嘲弄落败的球队。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「投机」——专门挑你的痛处说，专找机会激你；这只是谐音联想，与古法语来源无关。

root: 古法语 taunter、tanter（讥笑、挑衅）→ 英语 taunt（讥讽；奚落）；更早来源不确定，一般认为可能有日耳曼语族背景，核心义「用话激人」。

sensesIntro.en: Taunt starts as the act of jeering to provoke someone, gives a noun for the cutting words themselves, shifts to the target of the jeering, and finally widens to any deliberate provocation or bitter reproach.
sensesIntro.cn: taunt 先指用讥笑去激怒某人的行为，再名词化为那些刺人的话，又转指被讥笑的一方，最后扩展到一切故意的挑衅与尖酸的责难。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: someone shouting jeering words across a barrier to make another person angry.
core.cn: 核心意象：有人隔着栅栏尖声讥笑，只为让对方发火。

branches.en: Deliberate jeering is the basic verb sense.
branches.cn: 刻意讥笑是动词最基本的义项。

branches.en: The mocking words themselves become a countable noun.
branches.cn: 讥讽的话本身名词化为可数名词。

branches.en: The person behind the fence, the one being jeered at, becomes the taunt.
branches.cn: 栅栏后面被讥笑的那个人，成了 taunt 所指的对象。

branches.en: Words and gestures both serve the single aim of provoking a reaction.
branches.cn: 言语与动作都服务于同一个目的：激起反应。

branches.en: A taunt aimed at an old fault turns into a bitter reminder.
branches.cn: 讥讽的话一旦对准旧过失，就变成了尖酸的责难。

intro.en: Taunt is a single-root word borrowed from Old French, with -ing, -er, and -ly forming its small English family.
intro.cn: taunt 是从古法语借来的单根词，英语用 -ing、-er、-ly 等后缀构成它的小词族。

latinIntro.en: Taunt has no certain Latin ancestor; its recorded source is Old French, and the older Germanic link is only a proposal.
latinIntro.cn: taunt 没有可确证的拉丁语祖形，有记录的来源是古法语，更早的日耳曼语关联只是推测。

definition_en: the combined effort of a group of people who work together well toward a shared goal
core_image: 几个人合力抬同一根木梁，肩膀抵在一起，缺口处正好补上彼此的不足
scene: 划船比赛前，教练叮嘱每个人别只顾自己出力。Before the boat race, the coach reminded the crew that good teamwork matters more than raw strength.
sceneCN: 这里 teamwork 是「团队合作；协作」（第 1 个义项：一群人为共同目标互相配合）；句意：划船比赛前，教练提醒队员们，良好的团队合作比蛮力更重要。

pos.zh: 团队合作；协作；集体努力

forms.label: 不可数名词，无复数形式
